use generated_dmn::{Value, evaluate};
use std::collections::BTreeMap;

const NS: &str = "urn:rust-proof:multiplication";

fn number(coefficient: &str, scale: i32) -> Value {
    Value::Number {
        coefficient: coefficient.into(),
        scale,
    }
}

#[test]
fn matches_java_exactly() {
    let max = number(&"9".repeat(4096), 0);
    let max_product = number(&format!("{}8{}1", "9".repeat(4095), "0".repeat(4095)), 0);
    let max_twice = number(&format!("1{}6{}2", "9".repeat(4095), "0".repeat(4095)), 0);
    for (a, b, product, twice, zero, select_twice) in [
        (
            max.clone(),
            max,
            max_product,
            max_twice,
            number("0", 0),
            true,
        ),
        (
            number("999999999", 0),
            number("999999999", 0),
            number("999999998000000001", 0),
            number("1999999996000000002", 0),
            number("0", 0),
            true,
        ),
        (
            number("999999999", 0),
            number("-1000000001", 0),
            number("-999999999999999999", 0),
            number("-1999999999999999998", 0),
            number("0", 0),
            false,
        ),
        (
            number("-1000000001", 0),
            number("-1000000001", 0),
            number("1000000002000000001", 0),
            number("2000000004000000002", 0),
            number("0", 0),
            true,
        ),
        (
            number("1234567890123456789000", 2),
            number("10", 3),
            number("12345678901234567890000", 5),
            number("24691357802469135780000", 5),
            number("0", 5),
            true,
        ),
        (
            number("1", 4096),
            number("1", 4096),
            number("1", 8192),
            number("2", 8192),
            number("0", 8192),
            true,
        ),
        (
            number("-1", -4096),
            number("1", -4096),
            number("-1", -8192),
            number("-2", -8192),
            number("0", -8192),
            false,
        ),
        (
            number("0", 3),
            number("-4", -2),
            number("0", 1),
            number("0", 1),
            number("0", 1),
            true,
        ),
        (
            Value::Null,
            number("12", 1),
            Value::Null,
            Value::Null,
            Value::Null,
            false,
        ),
        (
            number("12", 1),
            Value::Null,
            Value::Null,
            Value::Null,
            Value::Null,
            false,
        ),
    ] {
        let input = BTreeMap::from([((NS, "a"), a), ((NS, "b"), b)]);
        let selected = if select_twice {
            twice.clone()
        } else {
            product.clone()
        };
        let expected = BTreeMap::from([
            ((NS, "product"), product),
            ((NS, "twice"), twice),
            ((NS, "cancelled"), zero),
            ((NS, "selected"), selected),
        ]);
        assert_eq!(evaluate(&input).unwrap(), expected);
    }
}
